# no-partially-commented-tag-lines

Disallow comments after tags on a tag line.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tags | no | no | none |

Finds tag lines that end in a comment, which hides the tags after `#`, and tags containing `#`.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-partially-commented-tag-lines": "error" } }
```
